cohort: This study included 460 singleton pregnancies delivered between January 2021 and January 2025 at Bursa City Hospital, categorized into gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM), or healthy control groups.
finding: Second-trimester HbA1c values above 5.3% were associated with increased risks of preterm birth, cesarean delivery, and macrosomia, although this association was not independent after adjustment for other factors.
mod_finding: Second-trimester HbA1c values above 5.3% were associated with higher rates of cesarean delivery.
